heading: Kitchens
content:
45.
Kitchens
(1)
Every domestic building, and unless exempted by the Building Authority any part of a domestic building which is intended to be separately let for dwelling purposes, shall be provided with kitchen accommodation.
(2)
The internal surface of every kitchen to a height of at least 1.2 m from floor level shall be faced with tiles or rendered in cement mortar, not less than 12.5 mm in thickness, or other non-absorbent material.
(L.N. 294 of 1976)
(3)
Every kitchen shall be provided with a—
(a)
properly constructed fireplace or cooking slab unless the cooking is to be done by gas, oil or electricity;
(b)
sink and fittings for the supply of water.
